quests.title: Physics Laboratory Master
quests.description: Conduct advanced physics experiments and master laboratory techniques!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Advanced Physics Laboratory! Dr. Newton needs your help to conduct crucial experiments that will unlock the secrets of motion and energy.

steps.title: Projectile Motion Experiment
steps.narrative: Set up an experiment to study projectile motion and verify theoretical predictions.

problem.question: A projectile is launched at 45° with initial velocity 20 m/s. What is its maximum height? (g = 10 m/s²)
